description: CIRAD and OBSYDYA project partners assembled a reference series for agricultural land use and land cover in central and northern Benin. The named CIRAD GeoDE DOI page opened, and its DataCite metadata describes spatially referenced observations intended for remote-sensing classification and mapping of farming landscapes. The collection links separate 2022, 2023 and 2024 Datahub entries, each of which opened as a generic year page. DataCite states CC BY 4.0 for the collection. The Data in Brief article title identifies labeled polygons across multiple sites and years; the official article abstract was unavailable through Europe PMC, so precise polygon counts, class definitions and file formats were not established here. Coverage is selected central and northern landscapes, not a national wall-to-wall land-cover map. Sampling and expert interpretation may affect class consistency between places and years; the year files and validation statistics were not inspected. A reviewer-assessed use is checking land-cover inputs or agricultural expansion assumptions in regional infrastructure and food-system simulations. data-updated-south-african-cropland-2013-2015 is a related cropland map, but no class harmonization was attempted. No data package or article PDF was downloaded.
